name: ThreeLevelLifts
description: Two lifts carry five boxes up three levels; an emergency stop and interlocks keep every move safe to start.

local.name: Stopped
local.comment: The emergency stop was pressed and the line has not been started again

local.name: StepA
local.comment: Lift A: 0 load at level 1, 1 settle, 2 rise, 3 unload at level 2, 4 lower

local.name: StepB
local.comment: Lift B: the same sequence, one level higher

local.name: SettleA
local.comment: Lift A: the box is still before the lift rises

local.name: UnloadA
local.comment: Lift A: time for the box to leave at the top

local.name: SettleB
local.comment: Lift B: the box is still before the lift rises

local.name: UnloadB
local.comment: Lift B: time for the box to leave at the top

local.name: Boxes
local.comment: Counts the boxes that reached the top

inputs.name: EStopOk
inputs.comment: EStop1.ok: TRUE while the emergency stop is released

inputs.name: BoxOnA
inputs.comment: EyeFoot.detect: a box has reached the middle of lift A at level 1

inputs.name: BoxOnB
inputs.comment: EyeMid.detect: a box has reached the middle of lift B at its bottom level

inputs.name: BoxAtTop
inputs.comment: EyeTop.detect: a box is on the outfeed belt at level 3

inputs.name: AAtLow
inputs.comment: LiftA.atLevel1: lift A rests at level 1

inputs.name: AAtHigh
inputs.comment: LiftA.atLevel2: lift A rests at level 2

inputs.name: BAtLow
inputs.comment: LiftB.atLevel1: lift B rests at its bottom level (level 2 of the plant)

inputs.name: BAtHigh
inputs.comment: LiftB.atLevel2: lift B rests at its top level (level 3 of the plant)

outputs.name: RunInfeed
outputs.comment: Infeed.run: run the belt that feeds lift A

outputs.name: RunTransfer
outputs.comment: Transfer.run: run the belt between the lifts, level 2

outputs.name: RunOutfeed
outputs.comment: Outfeed.run: run the belt to the bin, level 3

outputs.name: ARun
outputs.comment: LiftA.run: run the surface of lift A

outputs.name: BRun
outputs.comment: LiftB.run: run the surface of lift B

outputs.name: Green
outputs.comment: StackLight1.green: all five boxes reached the top

rungs.comment: Start: a press runs the line again, but only while the emergency stop is released.
Start: a press clears the stopped state while the emergency stop is released.
The emergency stop wins over Start: pressing it marks the line stopped.
The emergency stop wins over Start: pressing it drops Active, and every move with it.
Lift A settle time: a box on the lift is still for a moment before it rises.
Lift A unload time: the surface runs while the box leaves.
Lift A, state 4: back at the bottom, ready for the next box.
Lift A, state 3: unloaded, lower.
Lift A, state 2: at the top, unload.
Lift A, state 1: settled, rise.
Lift A, state 0: a box is on the lift, settle.
Lift B settle time: a box on the lift is still for a moment before it rises.
Lift B unload time: the surface runs while the box leaves.
Lift B, state 4: back at the bottom, ready for the next box.
Lift B, state 3: unloaded, lower.
Lift B, state 2: at the top, unload.
Lift B, state 1: settled, rise.
Lift B, state 0: a box is on the lift, settle.
Count each box that reaches the outfeed at level 3.
Surface of lift A: it runs only while lift A stands at the level of its step.
Surface of lift B: it runs only while lift B stands at the level of its step.
AUp: lift A rises in its rise step, with its surface stopped.
ADown: lift A lowers in its lower step.
BUp: lift B rises in its rise step, with its surface stopped.
BDown: lift B lowers in its lower step.
The infeed runs only while lift A waits at its loading level, so no box is pushed into a gap.
The transfer belt runs while lift A unloads, or while lift B waits at its loading level.
The outfeed belt runs while the line runs.
Green: all five boxes reached the top.
Red: the line is stopped.
